Opposition: Farmer Chandala Sadamma told AFP that when she sees the red-earth scars where her plot of mango and cashew trees once stood, “I feel like crying”. She was paid more than US$82,000 for the two-acre (0.8-hectare) stretch of land, but the transaction left a bitter taste.
Opposition: The Andhra Pradesh government told AFP that in addition to financial compensation, new housing is being built and handed over to people who had lived on the site.
Opposition: Activists in Andhra Pradesh are also demanding a moratorium on new data centres across the state until independent environmental and social impact evaluations are published.
